goal: Implement and live-verify a dormant content-addressed ExactItemInstance and EnhancementSelection cache, deterministically migrate every referenced sealed Community and structured personal gear template without changing active readers or the generation-32 Manifest pointer.
userValue: Imported and saved templates preserve the player's real intermediate-rank equipment and all canonical enhancements instead of being substituted with a BrowseVariant maximum or guessed values.
nonGoals: Do not switch the active Season Manifest, Catalog reader, Community reader or personal-template runtime path in this phase.
Do not update sealed Gear/Community Release rows or rewrite app.build_templates.
Do not implement ResolvedLoadout, SimulationSnapshot, full SimC compiler or task migration yet.
Do not materialize all historical exact rows or infer missing facts from another item variant.

mustChange: Add pure deterministic EnhancementSelection and ExactItemInstance identity/validation builders.
Add append-only dormant PostgreSQL exact cache tables, store and migration tests.
Add bounded Community and structured personal-template migration/shadow tooling.
Register Phase 2 owners, callers, plan and task-scoped evidence.
mustNotChange: Do not mutate cache.websim_active_manifest_pointer or any sealed Gear/Community Release.

riskUnknown: Sealed exact rows and template option keys may overlap or disagree on enhancement values.

evidenceRequired: RED/GREEN tests for SimC-semantic canonicalization, exact identity, intermediate rank, option/value mismatch and fail-closed evidence gaps.

A production candidate report classifying every active Community template and every structured personal gear template, deduplicating referenced instances, excluding unreferenced historical rows, and retaining generation 32.
Focused compatibility, full Harness, PR CI, candidate deployment, rollback and local/origin/cloud identity evidence.

consumers: future Loadout Resolver after a later explicit cutover

engineeringHealth.reason: This phase adds PostgreSQL schema and production dormant writes over personal/community template inputs. TDD, privacy-safe projection, bounded execution, exact identity, candidate shadow and rollback evidence are mandatory.

acceptanceEvidence: The same canonical instance and enhancement inputs produce the same keys and row hashes across repeated builds.
Intermediate-rank exact items preserve progression, ilevel, bonus IDs, verified static facts and actual enhancements.
Every active Community gear template and every existing structured personal gear template is explicitly classified with no silent drop or owner leakage.
Only referenced exact instances are materialized; unreferenced historical exact rows remain excluded.
The active Manifest revision and pointer generation remain unchanged.
Local full verification, PR CI, candidate/cloud parity and post-merge closure pass.

decisionLog.decision: The user authorized Codex to self-test and continue automatically without waiting for manual confirmation.
Phase 1 completed both dormant Catalog schema and active Gear Release migration/shadow; Phase 2 therefore advances to ExactItemInstance plus EnhancementSelection instead of repeating catalog work.
Exact identity excludes catalog, rule, source, owner and display fields; revision-bound static facts and provenance live in append-only validation rows.
Personal template shadow uses content identity only and never persists account identity in the global exact cache.
